Body.Content:
What and why

We are updating the entry point for Copilot in Outlook to be more visually appealing and consistent. Located next to the Outlook ribbon, the Copilot entry point makes it easier for users to discover and use Copilot as they work. In addition to chat, it also surfaces contextual, AI-powered recommendations based on the task at hand, such as reading email, composing messages, or managing a calendar. With a single click, users can act on these suggestions to quickly summarize content, draft responses, organize information, and accomplish tasks more efficiently. The experience is designed to bring relevant Copilot capabilities closer to the user's workflow while providing a consistent Copilot experience across Microsoft 365 applications.

This update is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 567007.

Rollout schedule

General Availability 

  • Worldwide: Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by late September 2026
  • GCC and GCC High: Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by early October 2026
  • DoD: Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by mid-October 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users licensed for Microsoft 365 Copilot who use supported versions of classic Outlook

Platforms and services

  • Classic Outlook for Windows
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot

What will happen

  • The entry point for Copilot in classic Outlook will be updated and located next to the Outlook ribbon: 

  • Users will continue to have access to the Copilot side pane.
  • This new entry point will surface contextual, AI-powered recommendations based on the task at hand.
  • The feature will be available by default for eligible users with the required Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
  • No existing Copilot licensing requirements or admin settings are changing as part of this update.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

We recommend that you:

  • Inform users that the Copilot entry point in classic Outlook is moving to a new location.
  • Update any internal documentation or training materials that reference the current location of the Copilot button.
  • Communicate the change to help desk and support teams so they can assist users when the new experience becomes available.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
